-- It's OUT! The last 3 months, I've been building out nearly 9 hours and exactly 100 lessons of this new UI Design Bootcamp!  Note: You will need to understand basic HTML and CSS to follow along with this course!

-- Why is designing user interfaces such a challenging task for beginners? 

Clearly, you can recognize great design, but when it comes to producing it, that's another story.

Hi, I'm Gary Simon and I've been a UI/UX designer for the last 2 decades as well as a frontend developer. I've created close to 100 courses and I'm back after 2 years with my largest course yet; The UI Design Bootcamp here on Scrimba.

My goal with this course is to help you create beautiful web-based UI's from scratch, as well as refactor existing designs.

Scrimba offers an amazing platform for mixing the world of frontend development and UI design. As long as you have basic knowledge of HTML and CSS, you will be able to follow along and eventually create great user interfaces.

I've included dozens of interactive design challenges that will test the knowledge you gain throughout this course. It's all about muscle memory, and that's why I've launched this course with exactly 100 lessons.

You're going to learn and apply all of the necessary UI design fundamentals needed to create amazing UI designs, you will learn responsive design, navigations, form design, card designs and so much more.

snippet.description:

-- Ever wonder how some of those amazing artsy sites pull off seemeless page transition animations?  It could be with the help of Barba.js. So, today, I'll show you how to quickly and easily get up and running with Barba.js along with GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) to handle the actual animations.

snippet.title: Figma UI Design Tutorial AND Contest!
snippet.description:
Visit http://linode.com/designcourse for a $20 credit on your new linode account.
-- Today, we're going to be stepping back into the world of Figma for 2 purposes: To design a fictional mobile app UI for a music company, and for YOU to participate in a contest to design a 2nd screen for the app UI!

I will feature the best entries on this Friday's LIVE UI/UX show.

To participate in the contest:
1. Download this .fig file: 
https://coursetro.s3.amazonaws.com/stuff/DesignCourseContest.fig

2. Drag it from your desktop onto the page: 
https://www.figma.com/files/drafts

3. Design the album details page with the REQUIRED information specified on the artboard. Make it a design that's consistent with the first artboard I designed.

4. Create a prototype between the two artboards (linking the featured artist thumb, new releases thumbs and the 4 results underneath) to your new artboard design.

5. Feel free to integrate nice micro-interactions / animations if you wish.

6. Create a shareable Figma Prototype and send out a tweet with the URL and tag me: https://twitter.com/designcoursecom (@designcoursecom) 

Enjoy!
